newsitem.title: USA: Stocker & Yale stake held by investor.
newsitem.headline: Stocker & Yale stake held by investor.

text.p: Investor Robert Chilton said Friday he holds a 7.8 percent stake in Stocker & Yale Inc or 200,000 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, he said he bought the stake on October 21 for $5.25 per share.
Chilton holds the stake for investment purposes, the filing said.
The company, based in Salem, NH., makes machine tool components, measurement and inspection instruments and lighting products and watches including authentic U.S. Army watches.
